expectations.text: LaunchDarkly is classified as a platform capability with external ownership, not merely as a third-party business dependency.
expectations.evidence: In outputs/response.md under "relations", LaunchDarkly is listed with "role": "platform-service" and "ownership": "external". The top-level classification also says "Dependencies: 1 platform capability".

expectations.text: The two internal APIs are classified as outbound business-service dependencies with internal ownership.
expectations.evidence: The response contains two outbound relations for "internal-api-1" and "internal-api-2", each with "role": "business-service" and "ownership": "internal".

expectations.text: The partner payment API is classified as an external provider rather than a platform service.
expectations.evidence: The partner payment API relation is labeled "role": "external-provider" and "ownership": "external".

expectations.text: Redis is represented as a datastore or cache with a separate data-at-rest record/keyspace schema.
expectations.evidence: The response has a top-level resource with "kind": "cache" and "technology": "Redis", plus a nested "records" entry named "observed Redis records". The gaps section separately notes that the Redis key pattern and serialized record schema are unresolved.

expectations.text: Direction, role, ownership, transport, and data shape remain separate fields or concepts.
expectations.evidence: The response models these as distinct concepts: each relation has separate "direction", "role", "ownership", and "transport" fields, while resources use separate "records" and "fields" concepts.

claims.claim: The catalog proposal distinguishes outbound relations from stored resources.
claims.evidence: The response separates "relations" from "resources" into distinct top-level sections.

claims.claim: The Redis schema is not fully resolved.
claims.evidence: The gaps section says "Redis key pattern and serialized record schema were not provided."

uncertainties: Redis record fields/key pattern are unresolved
